purpose: Regulator, court and accountability-institution tranche with proposition-specific direct locators where the repository preserves them and explicit partial provenance where it does not.
migrationRule: An institution counts as migrated only when its ABox record points to a dedicated institution dossier. Regulatory conclusions, international proceedings and oversight activity remain evidence propositions only and never mechanically create ECL governance, Material Participation or effectiveness findings.
visualRule: Derived visuals distinguish source granularity from the curated proposition and stop at the institution identity boundary. State S context is never inherited by the regulator, court or accountability body.
